newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 12.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Threats by student militants ensure strike widely followed at Ivory Coast's main university campus in Abidjan's Cocody district and at second campus in its Abobo-Adjame suburb; strike half followed at the inland campus at Bouake.
- Head of Abidjan's Cocody campus, Professor Hauhouot Asseypo, urges students to resume classes; says security forces will protect all wanting to attend lectures.

- Head of Ivorian state broadcasting network RTI says it will spend 1.2 billion CFA francs this year on boosting programmes to promote Ivory Coast's image as a developing economy; Ouattara Gnonzie says he wants the network to play a greater role in the economic, social and cultural development of the nation.
- Cloth maker UNIWAX announces a 10.94 percent increase in turnover in year to September 30 1996.

- Board of multi-national carrier Air Afrique to appoint Sir Harry Tirvengadum of Madagascar as its new managing director at a meeting in Niger's capital Nimaey on February 17; board also to choose a new chairman.
- Five-day strike paralyses Ivory Coast's universities; exams postponed at higher education collage in western town of Daloa
- Ivory Coast's Treasury Department organises a workshop to train senior staff in management of public funds.
